catalog.title: Capture and replay
catalog.question: Can Maxwell capture changes and replay their identities?
catalog.action: Create source data, capture events, then replay from the recorded binlog position.
catalog.expected: Captured and replayed events retain the same order and identities.

catalog.title: Schema, keys and value boundaries
catalog.question: Do supported schemas and exact values survive the version downgrade?
catalog.action: Exercise composite and changing keys, boundary values, schema changes and drop/recreate.
catalog.expected: Every intended event is accounted for; modeled schemas and values converge without DLQ entries.

catalog.title: Target transaction and journal recovery
catalog.question: Can interrupted target writes recover safely?
catalog.action: Inject failures around DML and DDL, replay events and introduce schema drift.
catalog.expected: Rollback, journal recovery, deduplication and drift barriers pass their direct target assertions.

catalog.title: Create a table and insert rows
catalog.question: Does MySQL 5.7 reproduce every planned change from MySQL 8.4?
catalog.action: Create a source table, insert the configured number of rows and add an index on value.
catalog.expected: Both databases match the expected table definitions and rows. Audit messages and target event records account for every planned change, with zero DLQ deliveries.

catalog.title: Update and delete rows
catalog.question: Does MySQL 5.7 reproduce every planned change from MySQL 8.4?
catalog.action: Create a source table, insert rows, update the same row twice, delete a row, and insert then delete a temporary row. Add an index on value.
catalog.expected: Both databases match the expected table definitions and rows. Audit messages and target event records account for every planned change, with zero DLQ deliveries.

catalog.title: Add a column while writing rows
catalog.question: Does MySQL 5.7 reproduce every planned change from MySQL 8.4?
catalog.action: Create a source table and insert rows. Halfway through, add a note column, update it on an existing row, then fill it on later inserts. Add an index on value.
catalog.expected: Both databases match the expected table definitions and rows. Audit messages and target event records account for every planned change, with zero DLQ deliveries.

catalog.title: Detect two missing changes
catalog.question: Can missing changes hide behind matching final rows?
catalog.action: Skip a planned temporary insert and delete on MySQL 8.4. The final rows still match, but two expected events are missing.
catalog.expected: The event comparison reports event-manifest. The host script checks that this is the exact error, then marks the verifier test passed.

catalog.title: Detect an incorrect target value
catalog.question: Does the harness detect wrong data even when event counts match?
catalog.action: Wait for the source changes to reach MySQL 5.7, then deliberately change a value directly on the target.
catalog.expected: The row comparison reports row-mismatch. The host script checks that this is the exact error, then marks the verifier test passed.

catalog.title: Stop services and repair target rows
catalog.question: Are changes retained across interruption without being applied twice?
catalog.action: Force the consumer to exit during writes, interrupt database and Maxwell services, and remove then restore a target row in two repair checks.
catalog.expected: The planned changes reach MySQL 5.7 exactly once. Both failed updates are retained and later repaired; repeated diagnostic deliveries describe the same original event.

catalog.title: Detect lost Pub/Sub subscriptions
catalog.question: Does the consumer report that its subscription has disappeared?
catalog.action: Restart the Pub/Sub emulator after the repair checks finish. Restarting clears its topics and subscriptions.
catalog.expected: The consumer reports the missing subscription and exits. The next test command creates new containers, messaging resources and test data.

catalog.title: Reject invalid JSON
catalog.question: Does the failed event remain saved while later changes wait?
catalog.action: Send {not-valid-json directly to Pub/Sub, then insert a source row. Restart the consumer and retry the saved message.
catalog.expected: One failed event and its original message are saved with a DLQ diagnostic. The consumer reports that it is blocked, retries fail for the same reason, and the later row remains absent from MySQL 5.7.

catalog.title: Reject an unsupported column change
catalog.question: Does the failed event remain saved while later changes wait?
catalog.action: Widen load_a.value from VARCHAR(80) to VARCHAR(120) on MySQL 8.4, then insert a row in load_b. Restart the consumer and retry the saved schema-change event.
catalog.expected: One failed event and its original message are saved with a DLQ diagnostic. The consumer reports that it is blocked, retries fail for the same reason, and the later row remains absent from MySQL 5.7.

catalog.title: Catch up while more rows are written
catalog.question: Do saved source changes arrive while the consumer catches up?
catalog.action: Stop the consumer while committing changes to both source tables and undoing another transaction with ROLLBACK. Start a new source binary-log file, restart the consumer and insert more rows.
catalog.expected: Committed changes reach MySQL 5.7; the undone transaction contributes no events. Table definitions and rows match, DLQ deliveries stay at zero, and the harness records processing times.

catalog.title: Complete scenario suite
catalog.question: Did every mandatory gate finish successfully?
catalog.action: Run all six gates in separate disposable projects.
catalog.expected: All gates pass. Event counts are reported for each individual run.
